title: Chapter 5 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of Styling, Assets & Metadata!

questions.question: Where must you import a global CSS file in a Next.js project?
questions.explanation: Next.js enforces that global CSS is imported only inside `_app.js` to prevent style ordering conflicts.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of CSS Modules?
options: They automatically generate unique class names to scope styles to a component
questions.explanation: CSS Modules produce unique class names, ensuring styles don't leak between components.

questions.question: You can use Sass with CSS Modules in Next.js without any extra configuration.
questions.explanation: You need to install the `sass` package (`npm install sass`) to use `.scss` files, but then it works seamlessly.

questions.question: Which command sets up a new Next.js project with Tailwind CSS pre‑configured?
questions.explanation: The `--tailwind` flag automatically configures PostCSS and Tailwind when scaffolding a new project.

questions.question: In Tailwind, the class `bg-blue-500` sets the ______ color to a shade of blue.
questions.explanation: The `bg-` prefix stands for background. The number indicates the shade (500 is mid).

questions.question: What prop must you provide to the Next.js `Image` component to prevent layout shift?
questions.explanation: Providing `width` and `height` allows Next.js to reserve space, eliminating Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).

questions.question: The `priority` prop on `next/image` should be used on all images to make them load faster.
questions.explanation: Use `priority` only for the largest contentful paint (LCP) image above the fold. Overusing it negates lazy loading benefits.

questions.question: How do you allow the Next.js `Image` component to load images from `example.com`?
questions.explanation: You must whitelist the domain in `next.config.js` under `images.domains` (or `images.remotePatterns` in newer versions).

questions.question: To make an image fill its parent container, use the ______ prop instead of `width` and `height`.
questions.explanation: The `fill` prop makes the image expand to fill its parent, which must have `position: relative`.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of `next/font` over traditional Google Fonts?
options: It self‑hosts the fonts at build time, reducing network requests and layout shift
It only works with variable fonts
questions.explanation: `next/font` downloads and serves the font from your own domain, inlining the CSS to prevent FOUT and layout shift.

questions.question: Which import statement loads a local font file?
questions.explanation: The correct named import is `localFont` from `next/font/local`.

questions.question: The Metadata API works only with static pages; dynamic data requires `next/head`.
questions.explanation: The `generateMetadata` async function allows dynamic metadata based on fetched data, fully supported in the Metadata API.

questions.question: How do you set the page title in the Metadata API for a static page?
options: Export a `metadata` object with a `title` property
questions.explanation: Static metadata is defined by exporting a constant `metadata` from the page file.

questions.question: What does the `openGraph` key in the metadata object control?
options: Social media sharing previews (title, image, description)
questions.explanation: `openGraph` sets the `<meta property="og:...">` tags that determine how your page appears when shared on Facebook, Twitter, etc.

questions.question: To set a title template like 'Page Title | Site Name', use the `title.template` property, where `%s` is replaced by the child page's title. The placeholder is ______.
questions.explanation: In the template string, `%s` is substituted with the specific page's title.

questions.question: Which Next.js component can be used in the Pages Router to add elements to the document `<head>`?
questions.explanation: The `<Head>` component allows you to append tags to the `<head>` section, but the Metadata API is preferred for new projects.

questions.question: Tailwind CSS utility classes can be combined with CSS Modules in the same component.
questions.explanation: You can use both. For example, a component can have styles from a CSS Module and additional Tailwind classes by importing the module and applying classes conditionally.

questions.question: Which Tailwind modifier prefix applies a style only on screens 768px and above?
questions.explanation: `md:` targets the `≥768px` breakpoint. `sm:` is 640px, `lg:` is 1024px.

questions.question: Why does `next/image` serve images in WebP format?
options: WebP is the only format supported
WebP provides better compression than JPEG/PNG, reducing file size while maintaining quality
It's just a default that can't be changed
questions.explanation: Next.js automatically serves WebP (or AVIF) when the browser supports it, because these modern formats offer superior compression.

questions.question: What must you set on the parent element when using `fill` on an `next/image`?
questions.explanation: The parent element must have `position: relative` (or `absolute`/`fixed`) so the image can size itself correctly to fill the container.
